title: Define the reusable exercise catalogue import standard
acceptance_criteria: The standard specifies the exact ordered fields for one exercise record and the text normalization rules used before parsing.
The standard defines record boundaries, stable id generation, array delimiters, common-error/error-correction pairing, and source preservation.
The standard explicitly excludes report introduction, monitoring/referral guidance, and references from exercise records.
The standard defines conversion of source exercise categories to Strength or Stretch without discarding the original category.
The standard defines incomplete-record rejection and a repeatable text-fixture extraction approach for ODT catalogues.
